specs.Compatible Devices: TVs, projectors, consoles, laptops, and more
specs.Other Special Features of the Product: Built-In Wi-Fi, Low Latency, Long Range Transmission

features: 【150M/492FT Long Range, Solid Metal Body】Screw-on external antennas hold a stable link up to 150M/492FT in open line of sight, so the player can sit in one room and the screen in another. Metal housing on both units, not plastic - runs cooler and takes knocks better on long installs. Walls, floors and furniture will shorten the usable distance.

【True Plug and Play - No App, No Wi-Fi, No Bluetooth】Transmitter and receiver pair automatically the moment they are powered on. Nothing to install, no home network to join, no pairing codes. TX and RX are labelled so you know which end goes where.

【1080P HD Output, Under 0.1s Latency】Sharp, consistent 1080P picture with latency under 0.1 second, so live sport, gaming and fast-moving video stay in sync with the audio - not just slideshows and static presentations.
【2.4G/5G Dual Band for Crowded Spaces】Dual-band operation lets the kit move away from a congested channel, keeping the picture steady in offices, classrooms and homes with many Wi-Fi networks nearby.

【Works With Any HDMI Source and Screen】Laptop, PC, set-top box, DVR/NVR, console or camera on the transmitter side; TV, monitor or projector on the receiver side. Mirror and extend modes both supported. In the box: transmitter, receiver, 2 detachable antennas, 2 HDMI cables and 2 USB power cables.
